name: playwright-bot
description: An RPA bot for Tray workflows: claims jobs from a Tray queue, drives a browser, reports the result back.

scripts.check: node --check src/runner.mjs && node --check src/config.mjs && node --check src/registry.mjs
scripts.docker:build: docker build -t playwright-bot --build-arg GIT_SHA=$(git rev-parse --short HEAD) .
